text:
marta: Quick kickoff — Avenio vignette. Need: final quote, legal release, webinar slot, inbound lead routing, and a sharp benchmark snippet for the launch post. Target launch window this month, Avenio requested a short embargo.

ben: Great — I scheduled the interview for Monday. I'll pull 3 soundbites (short), one long quote, and a draft blog outline after the call.

ashok: Can we include a single benchmark stat up front? Their infra team shared perf numbers vs our baseline; a percent improvement at p95 would be a nice hero stat.

claire: Customer said ok to share numbers if we anonymize competitor names. I will confirm exact phrasing and any internal-only qualifiers.

linda: Legal check — need signed release + redaction of competitor references. Please use the latest standard release template and attach customer contact for signature.

ben: Draft release text (starter):
```
Avenio grants Redwood permission to publish customer case materials including quotes and performance summaries. Redwood agrees to follow redaction requests and embargo terms as specified.
```

linda: Minor edits: change 'permission' -> 'a limited license', replace 'performance summaries' with 'non-confidential performance summaries', and add the confidentiality clause. I'll upload a redlined doc in a bit. Also note: we need a signatory name and title.

marta: Timeline proposal: interview Mon -> draft blog Tue -> legal sign-off Wed EOD -> embargo Thu 00:00 PT -> webinar + post Fri. Avenio requested 48h embargo, legal wants signed 72h before embargo. Might need to tighten.

tina: Ops/webinar note: propose Wed May 22 10:00am PT / 1:00pm ET for the 30-min webinar. Ops can spin up the registration page and recording. Anyone opposed?

ashok: Sounds fine. Also: can we push a short evaluation snippet into the post? Something like an efficiency or cost delta that sales can use in followups.

claire: Sales wants leads routed into SFDC campaign `AvenioLaunch` with lead source `webinar-av`. Also ask to add a custom boolean `benchmark_interest` for downloaders. I will coordinate with SDRs.

ben: Copy choices for headline (quick reactions please):
1) "How Avenio cut inference cost and reclaimed latency for large-scale telemetry"
2) "Avenio speeds up ML inference and trims per-token cost with Redwood"

marta: Leaning to option 2 — more direct. Also confirm embargo window with Avenio: they want 48 hours but prefer we get PR/press assets locked earlier.

linda: Confirming legal rule: embargo is fine, but final signed release must be in our possession at least 72 hours prior to embargo start.

ben: I'll aim to have the first draft 6-8 hours after the interview. If customer tweaks quotes, will flag changes inline.

ashok: Proposed benchmark copy: "Redwood reduced per-token inference cost by ~27% at p95 on Avenio's internal evaluation workload." Claire — confirm wording and approval.

claire: Avenio approved the number but asks we qualify it: add 'on their internal evaluation workload' and avoid calling out competitor names. OK to use the ~ symbol.

ben: Updated line: "~27% lower per-token cost at p95 on Avenio's internal evaluation workload." I'll incorporate into the blog and the webinar slide.

marta: Routing/ownership question — who owns post-launch lead routing and SFDC mapping? @cole or @jamie?

claire: @cole will own the SFDC mapping and campaign setup; @jamie will own AE handoff and follow-up sequences.

cole: I'll add `AvenioLaunch` campaign, set `webinar-av` as source, and include the `benchmark_interest` field in lead capture.

jamie: I'll prepare an AE playbook: 3-step follow-up (thank you email + benchmark snippet + CTA to trial) and map to lead scoring.

tina: Ops update — registration page draft is live (internal link in calendar invite). Added checkbox for 'I'd like more benchmark details' that maps to `benchmark_interest`.

ben: :eyes: prepping recording checklist and slide draft. Will add a slide that highlights the ~27% stat and a brief methodology note.

linda: Uploading the redlined release to the thread now. Please review and confirm signatory details.

marta: :thumbsup: OK team — reconvene right after the interview. I'll create a calendar event with all attachments and the final timeline. If legal sign-off slips, we'll push embargo/publish accordingly.

ben: Quick FYI — if quotes change significantly, suggest we run a 1-day extra review cycle so marketing and legal are aligned.

claire: Agreed. Also will remind Avenio to approve the final PR assets (one-liner, quote, and the hero stat) during the interview so we can speed things up.

marta: Thanks everyone — I'll post updates here as we go.

ben: Recording checklist link and slide draft added to the calendar invite.

linda: Final redlined release uploaded: `Avenio_Redwood_Release_v2_redline.docx`. Please use that for signatures.

ashok: Awesome. See you all Monday after the interview.
